fate.text: There was a battle on the road to Garaz. The 9th Legion marched south and encountered the 8th Legion on the road. According to eye-witness accounts, the unruly soldiers of the 9th attacked the 8th Legion over insults to its honour by Framander Manuchehr Dadaršu. Whilst Sakar Sohrab Daneshvar and Sakar Nima Dadaršu initially tried to reel in their forces, things soon got out of hand as they began to suspect the other side of actually wanting this battle. Nima Dadaršu did not wait for things to escalate slowly and immediately sought to ensure victory. He invoked the Sundered Realm and established a blood-pact with the Second Bloodroyal of the Ashen Court of Daemons to settle its debts to him. Word spreads that Nasr Baozhi has fallen to a grave illness and passed away in the town of Casman days after the passage of Sakar Jamaspa Tondar, who is on his way to the capital. His army has disbanded.

The long and arduous chase of the 13th Legion by the Eunuch-Sakar Uvaxştra has finally come to an end. In a campaign that has claimed nearly thirty thousands lives, the siege and battle of Yezi was the culminating point of the 3rd Legion in this months-long trek in the snow and rain. Both armies were on their last legs, but Uvaxştra's mages had recovered from their ritual back in the capital. Keeping to their speciality of summoning through the Wavering Realm, giant bog monsters of twine and moss were made to emerge through portals created in the nearby river, their size practically reaching the heights of the city walls. They lumbered to the front gates, paying no mind to the fire arrows which desparately tried to set their murky bodies alight. Azarmi Raisi - Sakar of the 11th - after negotiating the fall of the Empire's tributary system over the Suzerainity has reportedly disbanded her army and become a patrician in the city of Etaŕe using the leftover wealth of her army after paying her soldiers. The army - over 10,000 strong - have chosen to either stay behind in the Golden Cities (far from the chaos of the Imperial heartlands) or divided themselves into several mercenaries bands to be hired for coin.

Masišta Rašahpāiti, the Sakar of the 10th Legion who allegedly assassinated Tadjaro Olan, was found dead in his tent after his much-diminished legion broke into a row over pay. Apparently, his coup never really took hold, and the 10th devolved into an anarchy of cloak-and-dagger politics, where framander killed framander and desertion was rampant, until finally a civil war within the army led to the death of the sakar and the final destructive mutiny that heralded the end of the 10th as a legion. Most of its soldiers now roam the lands as mercenaries looking for pay and plunder.

Word comes from the Core with news of the culminations of events at Dayan. It is said that the Azure Legion and the defenders of Dayan [Alibasura the White Tiger and Naṣr Bàozhǐ, cherished son of the Fourth Legion's Sakar] met before the walls for a parlay. The matters discussed there is not known, but the following is said to have transpired: first, that Naṣr Bàozhǐ offered himself to be whipped to half-death by Šerobah Dašmiraqšad; and then, that a duel took place between Alibasura and Kozola Yamgaozhen, the torch-bearer of the Azure Heaven and the Magpie-whose-Cry-Wakens-the-World, a duel whereupon the White Tiger slew the Magpie.

This declaration by High-Priest Varun-ahun-Izadyar is accompanied with word of a play becoming increasingly popular in the far east of the Empire - undoubtedly sponsored by the High-Priest himself. It tells the the story of Farrokh Keykavous, from birth until death. Due to the lack of knowledge of the person before his rise as Framander, creative liberties were taken with his youth. The play does posit that his later service to the young dynast Varazdat and his scheming mother was something he was forced to do, as the Imperial Mother held the love of his life in her hands. Another major scene shows a confrontation between Keykavous' former and treacherous Sakar, Farzin Mahdavi, and himself; wherein the former openly condemns him for his treason; declaring that 'Avesta shall see you for what you are and banish you and your Argive gods to the deepest pits!"
